title: AnnotatedSnippet
description: Raw retrieval record produced during citation traversal. Carries the structured citation edges ASTA returns (refMentions + sentences), used to gate following and build citation_context, plus source_paper / retrieval_method provenance. Distilled downstream into an evidence_summary; refMentions / sentences do not leak past the summarizer.

text.description: The snippet text returned by ASTA snippet_search. Verbatim; the exact-substring quote source for downstream evidence.

annotated_text.description: Copy of `text` with each refMention span replaced in place by a standardized inline citation token: '[CorpusId:NNNN]' when resolved, '[CorpusId:unresolved]' when ASTA returned no matchedPaperCorpusId. Produced deterministically right-to-left over descending offsets so `text` is never mutated. Agent-facing input for the sentence gate and follow-id proposal; never quote from this field.

section.description: Section the snippet came from (e.g. Results).

score.description: ASTA retrieval relevance score (used as the coarse gate; carried through unchanged).

sentences.description: Sentence spans over `text` (ASTA annotations.sentences). Used to find the sentence containing each refMention.

refMentions.description: Citation mentions in `text` (ASTA annotations.refMentions). Each carries the matched paper's CorpusId (null when ASTA could not resolve it) and a resolved flag. Off-topic (methods) mentions are filtered by the sentence-level gate.

role.description: What the source paper IS relative to the corpus, independent of how it was reached.

retrieval_method.description: The MECHANISM by which this snippet was obtained. Orthogonal to source_paper.role. 'corpus_snippet' = snippet_search scoped to a corpus paper; 'supplement' = extracted from a supplementary file; 'citation_traversal' = reached by following a citation from another paper; 'free_search' = unscoped snippet/literature search; 'full_text' = extracted while reading the paper's full narrative text (JATS route).

SourcePaper.description: The paper this snippet came from. At least one of doi / corpus_id must be present.

Span.description: A character span [start, end) over the snippet text.

RefMention.description: A citation mention span with its matched paper. corpus_id is null when ASTA returned no matchedPaperCorpusId — a followable edge we cannot resolve (log, don't drop, when on-topic).

corpus_id.description: Matched paper CorpusId ('CorpusId:NNNN'), or null if unresolved.

resolved.description: True iff corpus_id is non-null (ASTA resolved the mention to a paper).

ReachedFrom.description: For citation_traversal snippets: the corpus paper this reference was reached from, the hop, and the citing sentence.

corpus_id.description: CorpusId of the citing paper, formatted 'CorpusId:NNNN'.

hop.description: Traversal hop at which this reference was reached (seed = 0).

citation_context.description: The exact citing sentence containing the refMention.
